measures.title: Term Limits for the Board of Commissioners (Senate Bill No. 469, Act No. 611)
measures.summary: Asks whether to approve a state act that limits members of the Forsyth County Board of Commissioners to two consecutive terms.
measures.yesMeans: County commissioners would be limited to two consecutive terms.
measures.noMeans: The act does not take effect and no term limit is set by it.
